title: Certified field model of elasmobranch electroreception: code and data
description:
Code and data accompanying the article An error-bounded field model of elasmobranch electroreception: canal funnelling, frequency tuning and the effect of body plan in a hammerhead shark and a manta ray (H. Talleb).

The ampulla of Lorenzini is treated as an electroquasistatic conduction problem and solved with a dual discrete geometric method whose primal and complementary solves bracket the dissipated energy from both sides, so the reported quantities carry guaranteed two-sided bounds rather than error estimates. reproduce_all.py regenerates every figure and every number of the article from scratch in about two and a half minutes.

Contents: a frozen five-module subset of the field engine; the model and figure scripts; the thirty-five parameter sensitivity and robustness campaign; and the two photogrammetric surface models used for the two body plans.
